function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web and return the top results with titles, URLs and snippets. Use it for recent events, prices or anything that changes.

function.name: create_image
function.description: Generate a picture from a text description. Returns the saved image file.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a document (Markdown, plain text, CSV, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or PDF) and save it to the chat. The user can open or export it.

filename.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.docx.

content.description: The file content (Markdown for rich formats).

function.name: memory_write
function.description: Save a fact about the user for later chats. Only when the user asks to remember something.

description.description: A parameter literally named description: kept by the compactor.

function.name: mcp_call
function.description: Call a tool of a connected app (MCP server).

tool.description: The tool name on that server.

arguments.description: The tool arguments as a JSON object.

function.name: get_time
function.description: Get the current date and time, optionally in another time zone.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run a short Python snippet in a sandbox and return stdout. Use it for exact arithmetic or data work.
